$comment: What a scene's `settings.category` is (docs/scene-icons.md "Category"): its name as people read it, a short line of text: the spaces, tabs and line breaks at its ends trimmed, 1 to `maxLength` characters, no control characters. `category` is what a runtime lists in app.frame.scenes, null for none (the value is ignored). Nothing maps it to anything: any such text is a category. Replayed by the SPA's sceneCategoryName (cloud shared-spa scene-icon.test.ts) and the runtime's sceneCategory (frameos/src/frameos/tests/test_scene_icon.nim).

cases.name: any name of the owner's own
